notes: Curated map-layer catalog with verified public endpoints. This catalog is visual context; it is not a numeric DEM sampling service.

layers.title: LROC WAC Global Mosaic
layers.description: Global LROC Wide Angle Camera basemap served through the public Lunaserv WMS.
layers.attribution: NASA/GSFC/ASU LROC; served by Lunaserv (Intuitive Machines)
layers.notes: Verified with a GetMap request on 2026-11-14. This is a rendered basemap, not numeric elevation.

layers.title: LROC WAC Color Shaded Relief (GLD100)
layers.description: Color shaded-relief rendering derived from the WAC GLD100 digital terrain model.
layers.attribution: NASA/GSFC/ASU LROC; served by Lunaserv (Intuitive Machines)
layers.notes: Visualized DEM product. The WMS layer is not queryable for numeric elevation.

layers.title: LROC WAC DTM - Numeric Rendering
layers.description: Numeric-rendering variant of the WAC digital terrain model, useful as a map layer.
layers.attribution: NASA/GSFC/ASU LROC; served by Lunaserv (Intuitive Machines)
layers.notes: GetFeatureInfo returns LayerNotQueryable for this layer (verified 2026-11-14). Use a local DEM for numeric sampling.

layers.title: LROC NAC South Pole Mosaic (2 m/pixel)
layers.description: High-resolution NAC mosaic covering the lunar south pole region.
layers.attribution: NASA/GSFC/ASU LROC; served by Lunaserv (Intuitive Machines)
layers.notes: High-resolution polar imagery for visual inspection.

layers.title: LROC WAC Polar Illumination
layers.description: Polar illumination map product covering the north and south pole regions.
layers.attribution: NASA/GSFC/ASU LROC; served by Lunaserv (Intuitive Machines)
layers.notes: Published illumination product; this API does not use it to replace sampled Horizons geometry.

layers.title: LROC South Pole Permanently Shadowed Regions
layers.description: Raster layer of permanently shadowed regions near the lunar south pole.
layers.attribution: NASA/GSFC/ASU LROC; served by Lunaserv (Intuitive Machines)
layers.notes: Useful as a planning overlay. Not used as a terrain horizon model in the MVP.

layers.title: Moon Trek LRO WAC Global Mosaic (303 ppd)
layers.description: Global LRO WAC mosaic published as an OGC WMTS layer by NASA Moon Trek.
layers.attribution: NASA/JPL Solar System Treks; LRO WAC data
layers.notes: Verified with a WMTS tile request on 2026-11-14. Imagery only; numeric elevation is not sampled.
